What this app is for
Data Harvester is the data collection tool of DATAra, the capstone project "DATAra: A Machine Learning-Based Mobile Data Depletion Prediction System for Prepaid Users in USTP Cagayan de Oro City".

Its only purpose is to collect the dataset that DATAra needs to train its machine learning model and algorithm for the global baseline of the system: the Global Model that gives every DATAra user an estimate of when their mobile data will run out, before the system has learned their own usage habits.

The data will not be sold, shared for advertising, or used for any purpose other than the DATAra capstone project.

Researchers
BSIT students of the University of Science and Technology of Southern Philippines, Cagayan de Oro (S.Y. 2025–2026): Gilliand M. Obial, Charlie C. Omongos, Cyber Storm V. Montejo, Dennis P. Gamayon, and Kristine Nicole C. De La Peña.

What is collected
• Mobile data used by the phone, every 30 seconds
• Data used by each app (app name), on mobile data and Wi-Fi, every 10 minutes
• Network type, signal strength, and network provider
• Battery level, charging status, and whether the screen is on
• Phone model and time zone
• A random ID created by this app

What is NOT collected
Your name, phone number, contacts, messages, calls, location, photos, files, browsing history, or anything you type or view inside apps. The app does not read your phone's hardware ID.

Storage
Records are saved on this phone and uploaded to the research team's cloud database, linked only to the random ID.

Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA No. 10173)
Your data is collected and processed in accordance with Republic Act No. 10173. Participation is voluntary. You may stop at any time: stop collection, use Reset to delete the records on this phone, or uninstall the app. You may also ask the researchers to delete your uploaded records by giving them the ID shown on the dashboard.

By tapping I AGREE, you confirm that you have read this form and consent to Data Harvester collecting your data for training the DATAra global baseline model, as described above.
